summary: Implemented and executed the Module 09 integration and regression test suite (verify-module-09.ts), validating pre-flight database isolation, core redirects, auth perimeter, anti-IDOR owner scoping, URL smuggling defenses, queue worker idempotency, and retention pruning with 100% pass rate.
evidence: Pre-flight Database Isolation: Confirmed NODE_ENV=test guardrail verified before test suite execution
Link Lifecycle: POST /links returned HTTP 201, and GET /r/:code executed HTTP 302 redirect with Location and Cache-Aside HIT
Auth Perimeter: Missing and invalid API keys rejected with HTTP 401 and standardized error envelope
Anti-IDOR Owner Scoping: Tenant B received HTTP 404 across GET, PATCH, and DELETE on Tenant A's link
URL Sanitization: Rejected 5 smuggling vectors (backslash, javascript:, CRLF, userinfo, ftp:) with HTTP 400
Queue Worker Idempotency: Duplicate worker execution with identical eventId deduplicated with single database ClickEvent
Retention Pruning: 30-day retention cutoff successfully deleted 45-day-old click while retaining 2-day-old record
Search Precedence: GET /links/search resolved cleanly before /:id, and page_size=500 rejected with HTTP 400
